description: Search the latest published cruise fares. This is the full crawl, including Contitrans and Crusit. Empty line, source, ship, or rate means all of that dimension. Values within one of those filters are OR; filters combine with AND. title, line, source, ship, rate, and sort ignore case. title is a substring. line, source, and ship must otherwise match describe_rates. nights, price, and ppd are inclusive min-max strings such as "8-14". departs is inclusive YYYY-MM-DD..YYYY-MM-DD. sort is field:asc or field:desc, comma-separated. Sort fields are title, cruiseline (line), source_label (source), ship, date, number_of_days (nights), lowest_price (price), price_per_day (ppd), and comment (rate). The default sort is Ultra, then All included, then Economy, then cheapest per night. Each row's price stays in its own currency.

line.description: Cruise line names. Case-insensitive. Comma-separated or a list.

price.description: Inclusive total price range in the row currency, such as "1500-4000".

sort.description: Sort such as "date:desc" or "ppd:asc". Several fields are comma-separated.

source.description: Source ids such as celebrity or contitrans. Case-insensitive.

title.description: Case-insensitive substring of the sailing name.

name: search_rates
